symptom: Interrupted import may duplicate history or remove original source bytes before a verified target exists.
direct_cause: Public append commits one operation at a time while source cleanup spans multiple files.
class_root: One migration transaction must own source hashes, deterministic target identities, prefix recovery and cleanup completion.
affected_population: v4 context records and direct pi envelopes
internal_only_reason: Approved private Nomi migration transaction; pi public appendMessage/appendCustomEntry/watch and SessionCreateOptions.id were checked in installed 0.85.1 declarations.
invariants: Archive bytes survive every append/cleanup failure.
Only a real transcript prefix of the deterministic plan can be resumed.
Completed imports never recreate user-deleted lanes.
No tools, credentials or provider are created during import.
generality_proof: All sources are validated and planned together, archived before writes, and resumed through one manifest/prefix boundary.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Own source/target identity, archive, prefix recovery, cold verification and completed cleanup.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Every source operation enters the shared append-prefix transaction.
Fixed import session IDs use the existing shared pi repository, never direct JSONL.
Only exact matching old preparation/completion bindings and contextHash identify recoverable agent-session bytes; provenance is fixed in the new transaction.

recurrence.reason: Any interruption between append operations or cleanup files can recur.
same_class_scan: Read pi AgentLane appendMessage/appendCustomEntry and public SessionCreateOptions.id.
Read openLaneSession shared repo and legacy cutover preparation/archive cleanup order.
Old projectAgentMigration archive path derives from preparation.startedAt; completion uses the same timestamp. G5 is never read.

prevention.invariant: Originals are archived before append; only verified prefixes are continued; cleanup completes before completed state.
prevention.failure_mode: Retain originals/archive and report a content-free error on source, target or prefix mismatch.
prevention.strategy: Single project admission plus file lock, preparation hashes, deterministic public append plan and two-phase cleanup.

legacy_paths.rationale: The old cutover is not invoked. This new transaction is the authorized migration boundary and old runtime deletion is step 4.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: Use pi 0.85.1 public session/lane APIs only, with no new dependency.
dependency_lifecycle.target: pi public append and session ID APIs
exit_criteria: Delete legacy runtime and host directories in step 4 after this migration is wired and verified.

migration: Fixed project context/agentChatV2 and exact host partition source paths; preserve original bytes in .nomi/legacy-archive; no G5 receipt path included.
residual_risks: Packaged C0 and seven-day L2 merge gates remain mandatory.

invariant_owner_layer.why: Only boundary allowed to decide an import is durable and its active source can be moved.
